_meta.openai/widgetDescription: This card already shows the user the full document: parties, dates, every line, VAT, totals and status. Reply in one or two sentences. Do not repeat or redraw the document, its lines or its totals, as text or as a table. Still mention any warning or note in the result.

description: Use this when the user asks about one quote or proforma invoice by number or id. One quote or proforma invoice by quote_id or quote_number: client name and TRN, lines, subtotal, VAT, total, status, valid until, and app_url, a link that opens it in Fatura Go. No client contact details. Do not use it to list quotes (list_quotes) or to change one (update_draft_quote).
